sloka: तौ सम्प्रचलितौ वीरौ मर्मभेदेन कर्शितौ ।निपेततुर्महेष्वासौ जगत्यां जगतीपती ।। ६.४५.१८ ।।।।
transliteration: tau sampracalitau vīrau marmabhedena karśitau ।nipetaturmaheṣvāsau jagatyāṁ jagatīpatī ।। 6.45.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Pierced all over their bodies with the heads of arrows, the gallant princes freed themselves from the cords by shaking violently like the banners of Indra. Pained by the hurting of the vital parts of both the princes, the Lords of the world fell.
translations.hindi: एकत्र हो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर बाणों' की वर्षा करने ' लगे । राक्षसों के दौड़ते तथा क्रुद्ध हो गजने का शब्द
